subject: SI onboarding: enablement pack & kickoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bridgepoint-consulting.com>; partnerships@bridgepoint.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SI onboarding: enablement pack & kickoff

Hi Elena / BridgePoint team,

Thanks again for committing to the partnership. Attached is a first-pass SI enablement playbook that outlines:
- partner motion and joint value props
- recommended enablement modules (sales, technical, demo, troubleshooting)
- sample demo lab and access instructions
- co-sell assets and handoff checklist

Could you review and let us know which modules you want tailored for your consultants? We suggest a 90-minute kickoff session next week to walk through the playbook and lock a training schedule for the next 6 weeks. Proposed slots: Tue 16 Mar 10:00AM PDT or Thu 18 Mar 2:00PM PDT.

Attachments: redwood-si-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)

Next steps: if you confirm the slot, Grace will schedule and Dev will provision a sandbox for your team.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bridgepoint-consulting.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@bridgepoint.com; Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@bridgepoint-consulting.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SI onboarding: enablement pack & kickoff

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — received the playbook and skimmed it this morning. High-level feedback:
- Sales module looks good; we'd like a short one-pager focused on ROI for L4 product managers.
- Technical module: can we add a short session about model fallbacks and latency-tradeoffs? Our implementation teams will ask about runtime controls and failover.
- Demo lab: we need separate login credentials for consultants and for customers (we can't reuse our customer accounts).

Kickoff: Tue 16 Mar 10:00AM PDT works best for our EMEA lead; Tom can host on our side.

Two asks before the call:
1) Can you share a SOW template and ballpark pricing for a 6-week enablement + 3 trainer-days?
2) Any compliance artifacts we can look at (SOC2 summary + data handling notes) for the sandbox?

CC'ing Tom to loop internal delivery.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director, Alliances & Partnerships
BridgePoint Consulting
elena.rossi@bridgepoint-consulting.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bridgepoint-consulting.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI onboarding: enablement pack & kickoff

Hi Elena — quick technical follow-up to the playbook notes.

On the model fallbacks / latency controls: we can include a 30-minute deep-dive in the technical module that covers:
- routing policies (how to prefer lower-cost variants and automatic fallback)
- prefix/KV caching and best practices to minimize cold-start latencies
- quantization tradeoffs and recommended coords for common CPU/GPU footprints

Sandbox access: we'll provision a sandbox org with two roles: "consultant" and "customer-demo". Credentials will be short-lived (14-day tokens) and logged to the audit trail. For compliance artifacts: I can attach a SOC2 summary and the sandbox data-retention policy.

I've attached a proposed training agenda (training-agenda.xlsx) that splits sessions into 90-minute modules and flags which modules should be recorded.

Attachments: training-agenda.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB); SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 380KB)

Let me know if you need specific API keys or sample prompts for the demo flows — I can pre-populate the demo lab with 3 templates.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (646) 555-0133

I've uploaded an updated playbook (v1.1) that incorporates the ROI one-pager and adds a short appendix on best practices for canary rollouts during partner-delivered deployments. See attachment list below.

Please confirm the headcount for the initial enablement: we recommend 8 consultant seats for the hands-on lab and 2 customer-facing demo seats. If you prefer more seats, we can scale but it affects trainer-day estimates.

- Marcus / Dev: prepare sandbox and pre-populate demo templates

Thanks,

Hi all,

Confirmed — BridgePoint will take 8 consultant seats and 2 demo seats. We reviewed the SOW template; a few procurement notes:
- We need a fixed-fee line item for the 3 trainer-days and an optional monthly support retainer (please provide a banded estimate).
- BridgePoint legal will want to redline the SLA clause around uptime for dedicated demo endpoints (we'll route redlines back to your contracts team).

On compliance: SOC2 summary looks fine; we'll follow up if our security team wants more detail on the sandbox audit logs.

We'll be on the kickoff tomorrow (16 Mar) — Tom (me) and Elena plus two delivery leads. See you then.

Best,
